position.description: Where on the car the part goes; n/a for non-positional parts (decoders, guides)

basis.description: Method class of the claim, weakest to strongest evidence family — NEVER a confidence float. dimensional = inferred from matching measurements only (explicitly the weakest class: dimensional match does not guarantee fit)

verified.description: true = a human physically mounted this part on this car. Vendor charts start false. A false Fitment is a lead, not a fact — skills must surface the basis

partTypeSlug.description: Denormalized part type path, e.g. tire/pgt-20124

carModelSlug.description: Denormalized car model path, e.g. d132/ferrari-296-gt3

partTitle.description: Denormalized part title for context-free readability

notes.description: Fit caveats — 'tight on rim', 'requires truing', chart-version cited
